claim: At least half of transactions occur online
originalWording: At least half of transactions occur online

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Online purchase transactions dominate ordinary consumer commerce; retail sales value is the stated empirical proxy.
reference.rationale: US retail e-commerce was only about 3.7% of retail sales in 2009, far from a half-share consumer-commerce interpretation. The 2026 Q2 US share was 17.1%, still below half. This does not decide whether a different denominator including interbank, stock-market or B2B messages might pass.

broader.criterion: Many forms of commercial transactions are digitally processed, including offline-origin transactions.
broader.rationale: Digital transaction handling is widespread, but this changes online purchasing into electronic processing and supplies no comparable majority-count denominator.
